blocks.text: Fossil has always been inspired by American creativity and ingenuity. Since 1984, we've strived to bring new life into the industry by making quality, fashionable elegant watches for women and accessories that were both fun and accessible. A professional woman can appreciate how women's wrist watches from Fossil will complement outfits with ease, so she can track time and look stylish all at once.

items.label: SPARKLING STYLE
items.value: This stainless steel women's Fossil Watch features clear stones around the dial, links decorated with shiny crystals, a stone at the 12-hour mark, a three hand movement;* an Adjust-O-Matic closure lets you self-adjust the bracelet

items.label: CASE & MOVEMENT
items.value: These women's watches have a 34mm case, 15mm band width, hardened mineral crystal lens resists scratches, accurate Quartz movement with 3-hand analog watch display, imported.

items.label: DIAL
items.value: The Jesse wrist watch has a round silver stainless steel case with silver dial and glitz accents

items.label: BRACELET WATCH BAND
items.value: Silver, durable stainless steel bracelet with an Adjust-O-Matic closure; up to two links can be easily removed without the use of a tool from this self-adjustable band

items.label: WATER RESISTANT LADIES WATCH
items.value: Up to 50m (165ft; wearable for short periods of recreational swimming and showering, but not diving or snorkeling; 5 ATM
